highlights.description: Initial release of omniagent-worker, a Go-first multi-agent worker framework
Minimal Worker interface for building task-oriented agents
Coordinator for managing worker teams with workflow support
Pool for in-process worker management (embedded use)

added.description: Core `Worker` interface with ID, Type, Version, Init, Shutdown, Health, Execute methods
`BaseWorker` implementation with configurable ID, Type, Version, and lifecycle management
`Pool` for in-process worker management with Register, Unregister, Dispatch, and Health operations
`Coordinator` for workflow orchestration with Pool integration
HTTP `server` package with RESTful API, health endpoints, and graceful shutdown

tests.description: Unit tests for `Pool` registration, dispatch, and health checks

documentation.description: README with overview, installation, quick start examples, and architecture diagram
PRD, TRD, PLAN, and ROADMAP specification documents
Add icons to README features section

dependencies.description: Add go.mod with dependencies: omniobserve, omnillm, eino

chores.description: Add GitHub Actions shared workflows for CI
